name: Jellyfin continue watching
description: A row on Home with where you were in Jellyfin, with the pictures; OK opens your Jellyfin app.
about: A card for Home with the films and episodes you did not finish on your Jellyfin server, and if you like the next episode of a series you follow: the picture, the title and how far you got. Each one is a button: OK opens your Jellyfin app, the official one, Litefin or Moonfin. Litefin opens the title itself (after its version 2.0.20); the others open on their own Home. The card talks only to your own server. Set up: Add-ons > Jellyfin continue watching > Set up from your phone. The TV keeps only the access token, never your password.
